gap: G9 / G1 - hardware validation of the co-signer
what_was_proven: An entry in the operator laptop's chain carries a second Ed25519 signature produced by a key that exists only on a physically separate machine, and that signature verifies against that machine's public key. The witness kept its own independent record of the same entry hash.

transport.type: Wi-Fi hotspot hosted by the operator laptop

distinct_keys.note: different keys prove the co-signature did not originate on the demo laptop

honest_bound: The tier achieved is WITNESS_COSIGNED, not FULL_CUSTODY. FULL_CUSTODY additionally requires a confirmed presence device, which is designed but not shipped. Claiming FULL_CUSTODY here would be an overclaim. What is proven is dual-party signing across physically separate machines - and that the chain still cannot prove nothing was withheld before it was written (G8, structural).
